rows.question: Write a short story about a student writing an essay (the title is "The Impact of Technology on Society.") and their experiences going through each of the stages shown in the image.
rows.prediction:
Once upon a time, there was a student named Sarah who was assigned to write an essay on the impact of technology on society. She was determined to complete the task and make it the best it could be.

Sarah began with the first stage, which was brainstorming. She sat down with a notebook and a pen, and started jotting down ideas and thoughts about the topic. She wrote about how technology has changed the way people communicate, work, and entertain themselves. She also considered the positive and negative aspects of technology and its impact on society.

As she moved on to the second stage, Sarah organized her thoughts and ideas into an outline. She identified the main points she wanted to cover in her essay and created a structure for her writing. She was now ready to start writing her first draft.

Sarah began writing her first draft, following the outline she had created. She poured her heart and soul into her writing, trying to convey her thoughts and ideas as clearly and effectively as possible. She wrote about how technology has revolutionized the world, from the invention of the internet to the rise of smartphones and social media.

As she reached the third stage, Sarah reviewed her first draft, looking for any errors or areas that needed improvement. She made corrections and adjustments to her writing, ensuring that her ideas were presented clearly and coherently.

Sarah then moved on to the fourth stage, which was revising her essay. She carefully read through her work, making sure that every sentence was perfect and that her writing flowed smoothly. She also checked for grammar and spelling errors, ensuring that her essay was polished and professional.

Finally, Sarah reached the fifth stage, which was proofreading her essay. She read through her work one last time, checking for any mistakes or inconsistencies. She made any necessary corrections and was ready to submit her essay.

Sarah was proud of her work and excited to share her essay with her teacher and classmates. She had gone through each stage of the writing process, from brainstorming to proofreading, and had produced a well-written and thought-provoking essay on the impact of technology on society.
